# Set-ZbxMfa

## SYNOPSIS

Changes an MFA method.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxMfa [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixMfaRecord>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Type <ZabbixMfaType>] [-HashFunction <ZabbixMfaHashFunction>] [-CodeLength <ZabbixMfaCodeLength>] [-ApiHostName <string>] [-ClientId <string>] [-ClientSecret <SecureString>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A multi-factor authentication method asks users for a second factor at login: a time-based one-time password or Duo Universal Prompt. The Set-ZbxMfa cmdlet changes the MFA methods given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with mfa.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every MFA method the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed MFA methods back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change an MFA method

```powershell
Set-ZbxMfa -InputObject 'Authenticator app' -CodeLength Eight
```

Makes the MFA method Authenticator app ask for eight-digit codes.

### Example 2: Change an MFA method and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxMfa -InputObject 'Authenticator app' -CodeLength Eight -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the MFA method Authenticator app back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixMfaRecord>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixMfaType`: Bound to -Type (ByPropertyName). The MFA type values: MFA_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -ApiHostName (ByPropertyName), -ClientId (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixMfaHashFunction`: Bound to -HashFunction (ByPropertyName). The MFA hash function values: TOTP_HASH_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixMfaCodeLength`: Bound to -CodeLength (ByPropertyName). The MFA code length values: TOTP_CODE_LENGTH_* in defines.inc.php.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixMfaRecord`: Mfa record class.
